# The KTX2 fixtures, each assembled byte by byte by its producer, using
# only Python's standard library. The suite states every expected level.
# fixture	producer	contents
bc7-linear.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	data BC7, 8 × 4, full chain of 4, level 0 alpha 128 and 255
bc7-srgb-premultiplied-translucent.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	colour BC7, 4 × 4, one level, premultiplied-alpha flag, level 0 alpha 128
bc7-srgb-premultiplied.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	colour BC7, 8 × 8, full chain of 4, premultiplied-alpha flag, level 0 alpha 0 and 255 only
bc7-srgb-straight-deep-translucent.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	colour BC7, 8 × 8, full chain of 4, no flag, opaque but for one level 2 texel with alpha 0
bc7-srgb-straight-opaque.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	colour BC7, 5 × 3, full chain of 3, no flag, alpha 255 in every texel inside each level's extent and 188 in the edge blocks' texels outside it
bc7-srgb-straight-translucent.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	colour BC7, 4 × 4, one level, no flag, level 0 alpha 128
refuse-1d.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	pixelHeight 0
refuse-3d.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	pixelDepth 2
refuse-array.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	layerCount 2
refuse-cube.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	faceCount 6
refuse-data-premultiplied.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	R8G8B8A8_UNORM with the premultiplied-alpha flag
refuse-dfd-block-size.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	a basic descriptor block 4 bytes longer than the descriptor holds
refuse-dfd-empty.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	dfdByteLength 0
refuse-dfd-not-basic.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	a vendor-specific first descriptor block
refuse-dfd-outside.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	dfdByteOffset past the end of the file
refuse-dfd-samples.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	a basic descriptor block of 24 bytes and 8 bytes of a sample
refuse-dfd-short-basic.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	a 16-byte basic descriptor block
refuse-dfd-total.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	dfdTotalSize 4 bytes more than dfdByteLength

refuse-kv-duplicate.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	KTXwriter twice

refuse-kv-no-nul.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	a key/value entry with no NUL
refuse-kv-padding.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	a key/value entry, key x, with padding bytes FF FF
refuse-kv-short.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	a 1-byte key/value entry holding only a NUL
refuse-kv-unterminated.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	a KTXorientation value of rd with no terminating NUL
refuse-kvd-outside.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	kvdByteLength past the end of the file

refuse-orientation.ktx2	make_ktx2_fixtures.py 1	KTXorientation ru
